title: Brand & Growth Marketing Manager
description:
About SEVORA

SEVORA is a multi-designer online boutique bringing together curated fashion from designer and homegrown labels. Through personal styling, Try at Home and fast delivery in eligible locations, we help customers discover and shop fashion with confidence.

About the Role

We are looking for a Brand & Growth Marketing Manager who can translate SEVORA’s positioning into compelling campaigns, build customer trust and generate measurable demand.

You will own online marketing strategy and coordinate execution across content, social media, influencers and paid campaigns. Your goal will be to attract relevant shoppers and turn their interest into enquiries, Try at Home bookings and purchases.

This is a hands-on role requiring strong brand judgement, creative thinking and commercial accountability.

Key Responsibilities

**Brand Positioning & Communication**

* Refine SEVORA’s positioning, target customer segments, value proposition and key messages.
* Maintain consistent communication across advertisements, social media, website, app and customer campaigns.
* Translate services, designer collections and customer benefits into clear reasons to shop with SEVORA.
* Develop content and campaigns that address customer objections and build trust.

**Campaign Planning & Demand Generation**

* Build monthly marketing plans around customer needs, occasions, collections and business priorities.
* Plan integrated campaigns with clear audiences, messages, offers, budgets and conversion goals.
* Generate qualified traffic, product enquiries, styling enquiries, Try at Home bookings and purchases.
* Develop focused campaigns for Kolkata and other priority markets.

**Content & Creative Direction**

* Own the content strategy and brief designers, copywriters, video creators and UGC partners.
* Develop campaign concepts, advertising hooks, creative briefs and landing-page messaging.
* Ensure content communicates product appeal, brand credibility and a clear next action.
* Test creative approaches and use performance insights to improve future content.

**Social Media & Influencer Marketing**

* Guide social media planning to strengthen brand recognition, engagement and shopping intent.
* Identify relevant influencers and creators based on audience fit, content quality and campaign objectives.
* Manage collaboration briefs, deliverables, timelines, usage rights and performance reviews.
* Connect social and influencer activity with measurable customer actions.

**Performance Marketing & Conversion**

* Work with internal specialists or agencies on paid acquisition and retargeting campaigns.
* Align advertising audiences, creatives, offers and landing pages.
* Review the customer journey from advertisement to purchase and identify conversion barriers.
* Coordinate with product, merchandising and sales teams to improve campaign outcomes.

**Planning, Budgeting & Reporting**

* Own the marketing calendar, campaign briefs and execution timelines.
* Allocate approved budgets and monitor spend against results.
* Run weekly performance reviews covering outcomes, learnings and corrective actions.
* Build a repeatable process for testing, measuring and scaling effective campaigns.

Key Success Measures

Performance will be assessed against agreed targets for:

* Qualified enquiries and Try at Home bookings.
* New customer acquisition and customer acquisition cost.
* Marketing-attributed sales and return on advertising spend.
* Website and campaign landing-page conversion rates.
* Growth in branded searches, direct traffic and relevant audience engagement.
* Timely campaign delivery and effective budget utilisation.

Required Skills & Experience

* 5+ years of relevant experience in brand, growth or integrated digital marketing.
* Demonstrated ability to turn positioning and customer insights into campaigns that generate demand.
* Experience in fashion, lifestyle, beauty, premium retail or D2C businesses preferred.
* Strong understanding of content marketing, social media, influencer marketing and paid acquisition.
* Ability to write clear briefs and evaluate copy, visuals and video content.
* Working knowledge of Meta Ads, Google Ads, GA4 and campaign reporting.
* Ability to interpret funnel data and recommend practical improvements.
* Experience managing agencies, freelancers or internal creative teams.
* Strong ownership, execution discipline and cross-functional coordination.
* Understanding of Kolkata’s fashion consumers is an advantage.

What We Would Like to See

Please share two or three campaigns you personally led, including:

* The business objective and target audience.
* Your role in strategy and execution.
* Examples of campaign content or creatives.
* Results achieved and what you learned.

**Compensation:**
Based on experience and demonstrated capability.

title: Socialpilot Template
description:
We are looking for an SEO Manager to own SocialPilot's organic growth across Google and AI answers, and to lead our SEO team while doing hands-on work alongside it. Search is being rebuilt by AI answers.
  
  
The role has two jobs. First, brand discovery. Grow how many new people discover SocialPilot every month, on Google, in ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Claude and Google's AI answers, on Reddit and YouTube, and in the lists and review sites buyers trust. Second, revenue. Turn that discovery into sign-ups, paying customers, and revenue. You are measured on both, not on traffic or rankings alone.
  
  
You report to the Head of Marketing on a weekly cadence. B2B SaaS experience is a must. You will do well here if you are revenue-oriented, AI-focused, and like to move fast.
  
  
**What You Will Do**
Grow brand discovery
  
  

* Measure brand discovery - Track how many new people discover SocialPilot each month, and where they find us, across Google, AI answers, Reddit, YouTube, lists, and review sites. Grow that number every month.
* Set the organic strategy - Sort our searches by what the searcher wants, and put the team's effort where buyers search, not only where volume is. Build the topical map and decide where we play and in what order, across comparison, alternatives and "best tools" pages, product and feature pages, content, and international. Decide which pages to build, fix, merge, or retire.
* Win in AI answers (GEO and AEO) - Grow how often ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Claude, and AI Overviews and AI Mode name, cite, and recommend SocialPilot, and how often they name us against our competitors.
* Run outreach and collaborations. Get SocialPilot onto the "best tools" lists, review roundups, publications, Reddit threads, and YouTube videos that rank on Google and that AI answers cite. Set Reddit and YouTube targets with the teams that produce for them. Build lasting relationships with publishers, partners and creators, and earn links and mentions through digital PR.
* Manage our listings and review sites. Own how SocialPilot appears on G2, Capterra, and other review sites, software directories, and AI app directories. Grow reviews and keep how we describe SocialPilot consistent everywhere, so Google and AI assistants understand what we are.
* Get the right content published. Work with the content team to plan, brief, and publish the content organic growth needs, on time. Review the search side, so every page answers a real buyer question well enough for Google and AI answers to use it.

**Turn Discovery Into Revenue**

* Grow revenue from organic. Own new sign-ups, paying customers, and revenue from organic search and AI answers, and keep growing them. Build the monthly forecast for discovery and revenue, and hit it.
* Put buyer pages first. Win back the searches where buyers compare tools, and make sure those pages lead to a trial.
* Diagnose and measure. Use Search Console, GA4, Ahrefs or Semrush, AI visibility tools and log data to find what moved and why. Check rankings live, by country and device, before reporting them. Tie every channel, including AI answers, to the sign-ups and revenue it brings, and turn data into decisions.
* Bring new ideas and test them. Do not wait for a brief. Bring your own ideas for more discovery and revenue every month, from what the best SaaS teams, our competitors, and new AI search features are doing. Size each one, and test the best with the cheapest test, a clear hypothesis, and a kill rule set before the data comes in. Stay ahead of Google updates and changes in AI search, and act on them.

**Lead And Run Organic**

* Lead the SEO team. Lead the SEO team and do hands-on work alongside them. Set clear weekly targets, review work, coach, and hire. Manage SEO tools and agencies within budget.
* Run technical SEO and guard every release. Own the SEO backlog with our web developers. Crawling, indexing, site architecture, structured data, page speed, migrations, and redirects. No page is removed, redirected, or moved without an SEO check, and every site change goes in a release log, so we always know what changed and when.
* Use AI and automation. Build AI workflows and agents with the team to research, brief, audit, and report faster.
* Work across teams. Partner with content, web, design, product, and paid to ship pages and fixes on time. Set the brief, hold the quality bar, and keep work moving.

**Must Have Skills**

* 3+ years managing an SEO team with direct reports, while still doing the work yourself. You have set their targets, reviewed their work, grown them, and hired. Informal mentoring does not count.
* Proven revenue impact from SEO. You have grown revenue through organic search and can show the sign-ups, paying customers, or revenue your work brought. You measure SEO by how many new people discover the brand and the revenue that discovery brings, not by traffic or rankings alone. You know which searches bring buyers and which bring readers. You have built an organic forecast and owned a quarterly number. You can walk us through a drop you diagnosed and recovered, or growth you built, and what it was worth.
* 8+ years of hands-on SEO B2B SaaS experience.
* A deep, current understanding of how search is changing across SEO, GEO, and how LLMs find, choose, and cite their sources. You keep up every week and can show what you changed in your own work because of it.
* Reddit and YouTube experience, such as growing a brand's presence in Reddit threads or in YouTube search.
* Hands-on with AI visibility tools such as BrightEdge and Profound. You know what they measure well and what they miss.
* Outreach and listings experience. You have gotten a brand onto third-party lists and roundups, run digital PR and link outreach, built partner and creator collaborations, and managed product listings on review sites and software directories such as G2 and Capterra.
* AI focused. You use AI tools every day, and you have built AI workflows or agents that made your team faster. You can show us one.
* You bring your own ideas. You spot what others miss, size it and test it without being asked, and can show us two or three ideas that came from you, not from a brief, and what they brought.
* Deep across technical, content, and off-page SEO, with experience on comparison and alternatives pages in a competitive category.
* Fluent in Search Console, GA4, Ahrefs or Semrush, and Screaming Frog, and comfortable with APIs, large exports, Sheets, or SQL.
* Visible and reachable in a remote team. You share progress and blockers without being asked.

Good to have
  
  

* Product-led growth (PLG) or free trial SaaS experience.
* Experience in social media, marketing, or martech software.

**About Us**
SocialPilot is a leading B2B SaaS social media management platform that helps businesses, marketing agencies, and teams manage, schedule, publish, and analyze their social media content efficiently. With thousands of businesses and agencies using the platform, SocialPilot enables teams to streamline their social media workflows, improve productivity, and drive better results from their social media efforts.
  
  
SocialPilot is now part of group.one
  
  
group.one is a leading European provider of online presence, cloud hosting, and digital marketing services. Over 2 million customers trust us with their online success. Our global team consists of 1500+ employees operating from nearly 20 locations across 15 countries, with our headquarters in Sweden. Thanks to the support of our partners Cinven and Ontario Teachers' Pension Plan, we are steadily expanding the group's service portfolio and geographical footprint.
  
  
When you join group.one, you become a part of a global network that values collaboration, growth, and excellence. Join us in creating online success stories!
  
  
**We are committed to an inclusive and safe environment, free from discrimination and harassment.**
**We welcome talent in all its diversity. Your gender, background, age, beliefs, or personal story do not define your opportunities here - what matters to us is mutual respect, personal appreciation, and creating a workplace where motivation and collaboration thrive. We believe in supporting your personal and professional growth, recognising you as both an individual and a valued team member.**
**We want to continue to grow with you and why we look forward to getting to know you.**

title: Associate Director - Product
description:
**About the role**

We are a house of D2C consumer brands on a shared commerce platform - Bewakoof, Nobero, Wrogn, Urbano, Veirdo, NautiNati, TIGC and Juneberry. That creates a specific kind of product problem: every brand needs a storefront that feels distinct, while the plumbing underneath — catalog, checkout, payments, order management, returns, offers, personalisation — has to be built once and serve all of them.

The Associate Director – Product owns both halves. You will run the consumer-facing product for one or more brands (web and app, from first ad click to repeat purchase) and, in parallel, own a set of horizontal platform capabilities that every brand depends on. You are accountable for outcomes on your brand(s), how quickly you can build/scale horizontal capabilities, how fast you can onboard new brands on these platforms, and how much of the stack they can reuse. AI is part of both halves of that ownership: you decide where models belong in the product, where they don't, and how the ones that ship get proved out.

The defining challenge is the range. You’ll move between a consumer experiment measured in days, a multi-system operational workflow where the edge cases are the actual work, and a problem that needs data engineering and data science support before a line of UI gets built. Each demands a different mode of thinking and the same rigour.

Why this role

Most product roles give you one of the two: brand-level ownership with no leverage, or platform work with no line of sight to a customer. This one has both. You will see what you build show up in a customer’s cart this week, and see the same system carry the next brand we launch.

**What you will own-**

**Brand product (D2C)**

1. Own the end-to-end shopping experience for your brand(s): home, category, search, PLP, PDP, cart, checkout, post-purchase and account.
2. Own the AI-backed surfaces on your brand(s): ranking and sort, recommendations, semantic search, and the GenAI pipeline behind catalog content and product imagery. Define what good looks like, how it is measured, and when a simpler rule beats a model.
3. Own
   **conversion rate, AOV and repeat rate**
   as primary metrics. Set the target, diagnose the funnel, and drive the roadmap that moves it.
4. Run a continuous experimentation programme — hypothesis, test design, sample sizing, readout, rollout decision. Kill what doesn’t work quickly.
5. Partner with brand, marketing and merchandising on launches, drops, campaigns, pricing and offer constructs, and make sure the product supports them without one-off hacks.
6. Own the mobile app roadmap where relevant: onboarding, notifications, retention loops, and app-vs-web parity decisions.
7. Bring the customer into the room. Use qualitative research, session recordings, support tickets, reviews and NPS alongside quantitative data — and hold the team to evidence over opinion.

**Platform product (horizontal)**

1. Own a defined set of shared capabilities built across brands to drive profitable growth and the roadmap that makes each of them work for every brand.
2. Own AI as a shared capability, not a per-brand experiment. Our ML and agentic services are multi-brand by design — one build, eight storefronts. You decide what gets built in-house versus bought, how models are evaluated before and after rollout, and where the guardrails sit: accuracy, latency, cost per call, and what the system does when the model is wrong.
3. Design for multi-brand from the start: configurable, not forked. Make the trade-off between brand-specific flexibility and platform consistency explicit, and document where the line sits.
4. Reduce time-to-launch for a new brand and time-to-ship for brand teams. Track and report both as platform metrics.
5. Work with engineering leadership on architecture decisions, build-vs-buy calls and vendor selection for commerce infrastructure.
6. Own the internal tooling side of the platform where it blocks operations — ops consoles, CX tooling, inventory and fulfilment workflows.

**Leadership**

1. Translate business goals into a quarterly/annual roadmap with clear priorities, sequencing and stated non-goals — and defend it with data.
2. Operate as the senior product voice with founders, brand heads and category leadership. Communicate crisply upward and give bad news early.
3. Manage and grow a team of 3–4 Product Managers + PM Interns. Set the bar for writing, rigour and customer proximity; run 1:1s, reviews and hiring.
4. Set the direction and run execution with rigour - decide what the team works on and why, discovery cadence, make sure solutions are thought through before they hit a sprint, spec quality, launch plans, experiment governance, prove impact after release, and grow a team of PMs into stronger operators.
5. This is a builder’s role with a small team. You will still write specs, build working prototypes with AI tools, sit in on user calls, look at funnels yourself, and argue about the details of tech, business and analytics.

**What we are looking for**

Must have

1. **8–12 years**
   of total experience, with at least
   **5 in product management**
   and
   **2+ directly managing product managers**
   as their reporting manager, owning performance, growth and levelling. Managing interns, project managers or a dotted-line team does not meet this bar.
2. Proven ownership of a consumer-facing D2C, e-commerce or marketplace product at real scale, with revenue accountability.
3. Hands-on experience with commerce fundamentals: catalog, search and discovery, cart and checkout, payments, promotions, order management and returns.
4. Strong analytical ability - SQL or equivalent, funnel analysis, cohort and retention analysis, A/B test design and interpretation. You pull and question the numbers yourself rather than just receiving them.
5. Demonstrated experience building platform or horizontal capabilities used by multiple teams or brands, and navigating the configurability-vs-consistency trade-off.
6. **AI judgment**
   - you have shipped at least one AI or ML-backed feature and can explain how you evaluated it, what it costs to run, and a case where you decided against a model. And you use AI tooling in your own work - prototyping, analysis, synthesis.
7. Excellent written and verbal communication. Clear specs, sharp documents, and the ability to make a case to a senior audience.
8. Genuine craft sensibility - you can tell good UX from bad and will push design and engineering to a higher bar.
9. **Systems thinking**
   - you can reason across data flows, integrations and edge cases, and hold a multi-system workflow in your head.
10. **Stakeholder management**
    - you can hold your own with founders, business heads and functional leaders.

**Good to have**

1. Experience in fashion, apparel, beauty or lifestyle categories.
2. Experience launching a brand or a new business line from zero to one.
3. Familiarity with modern commerce stacks - headless storefronts, commerce engines, CDPs, martech and CRM tooling, recommendation and personalisation systems.
4. Exposure to India-specific commerce realities: COD, RTO, tier-2/3 buyer behaviour, quick commerce, vernacular and low-bandwidth performance constraints.
5. Experience partnering closely with supply chain and CX teams on post-purchase experience.
6. Experience in operations, supply chain, marketing or internal platforms — you've built for users whose day job is running the business, and you understand why that's harder than consumer product, not easier.
7. Depth in AI product — you have owned an ML-backed or agentic surface end to end, including data, evaluation, rollout and the fallback when it fails, or built LLM-based automation that held up at real volume.

title: Head of Product
description:
About Wualt

Wualt is building a connected safety wearable for women: a smart ring and mobile app that let someone signal for help discreetly and keep the people they trust informed. Designed and built in India, the product brings together hardware, firmware, software and applied ML. Pilots are live, and we are working towards a national launch in 2027.

We are hiring a Head of Product to lead the product end to end and turn what we learn from pilots into a reliable experience people can trust.

The role

This is our most senior product role, reporting to the founders. You will own the product vision, priorities and roadmap across the ring, dock, firmware, app, backend and ML, bringing the work of engineering, data, design and quality together around a shared plan.

You will stay close to users and the technical details, give teams clear ownership, and resolve difficult trade-offs and blockers. You will lead and grow the product function, working closely with the founders and functional leads to align delivery plans, resources and launch decisions.

Brand and growth own marketing, positioning and campaigns. You will partner with them on launch readiness, ensuring the product experience and the promises we make about it stay aligned.

What you will own

Product strategy and priorities. Set a clear direction and an achievable roadmap from pilots through launch and beyond. Make explicit choices about what to build, what to defer and why.

User learning and pilots. Lead the pilot programme, understand how women use the product in practice, and turn feedback and evidence into product decisions. Test the full experience, from setup and everyday use to signalling for help.

Delivery across teams. Coordinate hardware, firmware, app, backend and ML milestones. Surface dependencies early, agree owners and acceptance criteria, and help teams resolve blockers.

Reliability and launch readiness. Define readiness criteria with engineering and quality. Own the integrated delivery plan, making risks and trade-offs between timing, scope and quality clear before launch decisions.

Safety, privacy and trust. Keep claims grounded in what the product can reliably detect and notify. Work with the relevant specialists on privacy, data protection and applicable requirements, and make limitations clear in the experience.

Product measures and improvement. Define and track measures such as alert reliability, notification latency, activation and retention, alongside user feedback. Use them to guide improvements through launch and beyond.

People and leadership. Build the product function, develop people, and establish a clear way to make decisions and review progress. Create accountability while giving teams the ownership to deliver.

What you will bring

Experience leading products from development to launch and improving them in production, with clear examples of your decisions and their outcomes.

The ability to set product direction and lead delivery across disciplines, balancing user needs, technical constraints and business priorities.

Enough technical depth to discuss hardware, firmware, mobile software, backend systems and applied ML with specialists, ask good questions and make informed trade-offs.

Experience leading teams through ambiguity, setting clear priorities and resolving dependencies without becoming the bottleneck.

Sound judgement about reliability, privacy and user trust, and a willingness to challenge a date or a claim when the evidence does not support it.

A collaborative approach to working with founders, engineering, design and brand, and the ability to explain decisions clearly.

Experience bringing a physical or connected product to market is strongly preferred, particularly a wearable, consumer-electronics product or hardware-plus-app system. Familiarity with hardware timelines, firmware releases, certification and manufacturing constraints will be valuable.

Additional experience we value

Wearables, safety, health or products combining hardware and services. Consumer products you helped launch and scale, including direct-to-consumer businesses. Working with applied-ML teams on a shipped product. Building a product function in an early-stage company.

Your first six to twelve months

Establish a shared assessment of the product, pilot findings and launch risks, with clear priorities and owners. Build and lead an integrated roadmap towards the 2027 national launch, with agreed readiness criteria and visible dependencies. Translate pilot learning into improvements across the ring, app and alert experience, and validate those improvements with users. Put product measures and regular decision reviews in place so teams can see progress and address risks early. Align product readiness with brand and growth so launch communications accurately reflect the experience we can deliver.

What we offer

Company-wide product ownership, direct access to the founders, and a team already working across hardware, software and ML. The role offers a competitive salary and meaningful equity, with the opportunity to grow into Chief Product Officer as the company and the scope of the role expand. This is a full-time, on-site role in Chennai, working closely with the team building the product.

How to apply

Email your resume or LinkedIn profile to sunil@armortrixtech.com, with a short note about a product you helped bring to market, what you personally owned and why Wualt interests you.

title: Product Manager
description:
**About Techdome**
At Techdome, we turn AI ambition into enterprise-grade products. Our engineers, designers, and AI specialists build LLM-powered applications, RAG systems, conversational assistants, autonomous agents, and workflow automation for clients in FinTech, Healthcare, E-commerce, EdTech, Logistics, and SaaS. Every product ships with the integrations, security, and compliance that enterprise clients demand.
  
  
**Why This Role Exists**
Anyone can get a GenAI prototype working in a weekend. The hard part is everything after: passing a security review, staying inside budget, keeping costs per query sane, and earning the trust of real users.
  
  
We’re looking for a Product Manager who treats that hard part as the real job. You’ll own products end to end, from the first client conversation through launch and long-term growth, and you’ll be the person who spots the vague requirement, the missed handoff, or the quiet risk while it’s still cheap to fix.
  
  
**What You’ll Own**
**Product vision and scope**

* Shape a client’s idea into a clear product definition with realistic milestones, timelines, and budgets.
* Go deep on each client’s industry, regulations, and compliance obligations, and convert them into requirements engineers can build from without guessing.

**Taking GenAI from prototype to production**

* Partner with ML engineers to harden LLM, RAG, agent, and automation prototypes into reliable, scalable, and safe systems.
* Define the metrics that matter in production, including accuracy, latency, evaluation scores, and cost per query, and review them continuously.
* Make sure every AI feature integrates cleanly with client systems via APIs and meets enterprise expectations for security, data privacy, and uptime.

**Leading across disciplines**

* Align UI/UX, frontend, backend, mobile, QA, DevOps, and business analysts so handoffs are explicit and nothing relies on assumption.
* Plan team capacity and keep every party accountable to their commitments.
* Manage third-party partners, including LLM and cloud providers.

**Managing risk, change, and communication**

* Run structured change control whenever scope, timeline, or budget shifts.
* Surface and escalate delivery, technical, and AI-specific risks early: hallucinations, prompt injection, data leakage, bias, and runaway costs.
* Track work in JIRA or Azure DevOps and give clients and leadership clear, no-surprise updates.
* Use AI tools to accelerate documentation, planning, tracking, and reporting.

**What You Bring**
**Must have**

* 2+ years as a Product Manager shipping complex enterprise software on time and on budget.
* Hands-on GenAI experience, ideally having launched at least one LLM, RAG, or agent-based product, plus a solid grasp of the AI lifecycle and its risks.
* A track record of leading cross-functional teams across design, engineering, QA, and DevOps.
* Working knowledge of Agile (Scrum/Kanban) and Waterfall, and of tools like JIRA, Azure DevOps, Trello, or Asana.
* Enough technical depth in the SDLC, APIs, microservices, databases, cloud (AWS/Azure/GCP), and CI/CD to challenge estimates and earn engineers’ respect.
* Sound judgment on risk, change, vendors, and stakeholders.
* Clear, confident written and verbal communication, including with senior client executives.

**Nice to have**

* Familiarity with LLM evaluation, guardrails, and cost-optimization practices.
* PMP, PRINCE2, CSM, CSPO, or an AI/cloud certification.
* Deep domain expertise in FinTech or Healthcare.
* Experience across industries and the curiosity to pick up a new one fast.

**How We’ll Measure Success**

* Day 30: You know how Techdome delivers, you’ve met the team, and you’re up to speed on active client projects.
* Day 60: You independently lead at least one project, owning the plan, the risks, and the client relationship.
* Day 90: You land a key milestone, make a visible improvement to how we run projects, and have earned the trust of both team and clients.

**What’s In It For You**

* Technically demanding GenAI work across multiple industries.
* Daily collaboration with seasoned designers, engineers, QA specialists, and AI experts.
* A genuine say in how projects are planned, run, and delivered.
* Room to build deep expertise at the frontier of GenAI.

This role requires a high level of expertise and operational oversight—from understanding how the building functions top to bottom to governance of contractor team performance and ensuring financial accountability. You will work in close strategic partnership with our integrated facilities management partner, establishing clear expectations, maintaining strong governance, addressing performance gaps, and ensuring services meet Stripe’s operational and workplace experience standards.
  
  
You will also play a critical role in managing operational incidents and disruptions. This requires remaining calm under pressure, bringing structure to ambiguity, coordinating the appropriate internal and external partners, communicating clearly with stakeholders, and translating lessons from incidents into durable operational improvements.
  
  
A key part of the role is anticipating the needs of the business by understanding both the site and the broader context of company growth. You will gather and synthesize feedback from multiple sources to ensure the workplace strategy is informed by real insights from the ground. While enterprise workplace strategy is developed centrally, you are expected to bring informed recommendations based on local business needs and operational insight, and to own successful implementation and adoption at your site. * Strong demonstrated ability in facilities management, vendor, and budget management

We are looking for a hands-on Manager to lead Integrations for a portfolio of US-based clients, working in the US shift. * 5. Drive client leadership connects with US clients through demos and meetups, in their time zone — showcase integration capabilities, walk through solution approaches, align on roadmap priorities, and strengthen executive-level confidence in delivery.
* 6. Own escalations and production issues on integration interfaces during US hours — debug failures, unblock consultants on complex interface problems, restore stable data flows, and communicate status to client stakeholders.
* 7. Stay hands-on with Python and integration tooling to review, guide, and when required , contribute to builds and troubleshooting on integration interfaces.
* 8. Build on the team's existing use of AI for solutioning and writing code — as a quick learner, strengthen AI-assisted design, coding, review, and documentation practices so the team delivers faster with consistent quality.
* 9. Partner with India-based Product/Engineering teams on platform capabilities, ensuring clean handoffs across time zones on integration patterns and enhancements needed for scalable client solutions.
* 10. Build and maintain solutioning standards, reusable patterns, and technical documentation so the team can deliver consistently as engagement volume grows.

* 6-10 years of experience in technical consulting, integration solutioning/development, or similar roles within HRTech/SaaS or enterprise software.
* Proven experience managing Technical Consultants or similar delivery teams (3+ years in a people-management role) — including hiring, performance management, quality oversight, and owning delivery outcomes.
* Strong hands-on programming ability in Python — comfortable writing, reading, reviewing, and debugging integration code.
* Solid expertise in system integrations (REST/SOAP APIs, file-based integrations, middleware) with the ability to design and solution complex integration landscapes.
* Demonstrated ability to help teams diagnose and resolve issues on integration interfaces in production environments.
* Experience engaging client leadership through demos, technical meetups, and executive-facing solution discussions.
* Experience working with US/North American clients, and willingness to work the US shift on a sustained basis.

* Excellent client-facing communication and stakeholder management skills — able to explain technical designs clearly and lead solution discussions with both technical and leadership audiences.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving mindset with the ability to balance leadership responsibilities and hands-on technical contribution.

Good to Have
  
  

* JavaScript experience — a plus for integration builds, scripting, and related client-side or middleware work.
* Prior direct experience with the Darwinbox platform or similar HRMS/HCM products.

Within the first two quarters, this person will have become the trusted integrations lead for US client leadership, established clear ownership of integration solutioning and development quality across their team, built a strong rhythm of client leadership demos and meetups, helped stabilize and resolve complex integration interface issues, and strengthened the team's existing AI-driven approach to solutioning and coding — leaving behind a high-performing US-shift Technical Consultant team capable of scaling delivery with consistent quality.
